resources.string:
For questions that come back, asked one per screen, answered whenever you like or at planned times: an evening review, a weekly check-in.
## What it does
- Its own schedule of invitations, each with a notification
- Answering alone, or with the AI from a prepared message
- An unanswered invitation stays visible, marked as ignored
## Not made for
- A single value noted quickly (Tracking)

## The questions
Each of the tool's fields is a question, in the order of the fields. Fields are added in the common settings, as for any tool.

## The invitations
- Invitations: the times the questionnaire is to be filled in, with a notification
- Notify: unchecked, the invitations come without a notification
- Active: unchecked, no invitation is created any more
- Expires: when an invitation left to fill expires — never, at the next one (one alone is then left to fill), or after a delay

## With the AI
- Message to the AI: the message that opens the conversation when answering “With the AI”, to send as it is or to change

## To fill
The invitations waiting.
- Fill: the questions, one per screen, with Previous to go back
- With the AI: a conversation where the AI asks you the questions
- Ignore: skip this time, keeping it in the history
- Ignore all: skip all those that piled up

## Without an invitation
- Fill in now, or With the AI

## The history
Each time, filled or ignored.
- Change: corrects the answers of that time
Questions asked one per screen, when you want or at planned times
Switched off, no invitation is created
What a chat “with the AI” opens with, to send or change; the pointer to what to fill goes with it
Ask me the questions of this questionnaire one at a time. If an answer is vague, ask again. Before recording, show me the values you will write, then fill the entry and mark it filled.
to_fill, filled, ignored or expired (left to fill past the questionnaire\'s expiry); an entry is filled by the questionnaire's operation complete, after its answers are written
When the entry was filled, which can be later than the moment it is about
Marks an entry filled, once its answers are written (UPDATE_DATA); gaps are allowed
Marks an entry ignored: a gap chosen, kept in the history
Ignores every entry still to fill
This questionnaire has no question yet: add fields in its settings
The moment the sitting is about: the planned time of an invitation, or the moment chosen when it is filled in without one
The answers: each of the user\'s fields is a question of the questionnaire, asked one per screen
Whether the sitting is to fill, filled or ignored, and when it was filled
Invites to fill the questionnaire now, beside its schedule: an entry to fill dated now, its notification and its event as a planned invitation's
